detail: 11/11 acceptance tests pass in both --dev and production timing; no races

note: CORRECTION: early single-shot profiles read 248us and attributed 64% to SFPU sigmoid. Re-measurement showed 248us was a transient environmental effect (same config reproducibly 102us later), AND the per-phase zone wraps each helper INCLUDING its cb_wait_front, so a starved phase reads as a slow phase. True profile: no phase dominates (p2 21%, p4 17%, p7b 16%, p7c 14%, p1 12%); op is near DRAM roofline.

conclusion: sigmoid payload is REAL SFPU work (152us of 244us at B1/T640, 2.65x headroom); moving it to the PACK thread is 0.992x (small consistent regression) because MATH and PACK share ONE SFPU per Tensix and are lock-stepped by DEST half-sync
